CHAPTER.CAPTION: To the chief Musician. A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
CHAPTER.VERS: Lord, You have been gracious to Your land; You have brought back the captivity of Jacob.
You have forgiven the iniquity of Your people; You have covered all their sin. Selah
You have withdrawn all Your wrath; You have drawn back from Your burning anger.
Restore us, O God of our salvation, and make a break in Your anger toward us.
Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger from generation to generation?
Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?
Show us Your mercy, Jehovah, and grant us Your salvation.
I will hear what Jehovah the Mighty God will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints; but let them not turn back to folly.
Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that glory may dwell in our land.
Mercy and truth have met together; righteousness and peace have kissed.
Truth shall spring out of the earth, and righteousness shall look down from Heaven.
Yea, Jehovah will give good; and our land shall yield its increase.
Righteousness shall go before Him, and shall set us in the way of His steps.
